notes.title: Before You Buy!
notes.content:
Hi there everyone,

We came up with some information regarding Before Sunset 日落之前 in this little post. Keeping things short and sweet so you can quickly understand more about the game before you purchase! ːsteamhappyː

[h3][b]Project Introduction[/b][/h3]
Before Sunset is a 1.5 years indie horror game project created by 2 siblings. We have worked hard to ensure it is a major step up from our last project, Noctambulant, and that players will experience the fear and tension alongside with the story and lore.

[h3][b]Playtime[/b][/h3]
Through our testers & players, we have estimated an average range of 4-5 hours of casual gameplay!

[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3] [No Spoilers] 
Before Sunset is packed with a lot of content. In this game :

[olist]
[*] You will solve puzzles, doing your best to survive, hide, run and stay alive.
[*] You get to explore the map as you like, choose to talk to different characters in game to learn about them and piece the story together, which we highly recommend.
[*] There will be lots of storytelling with hand-drawn illustrations.
[/olist]

[h3][b]Help[/b][/h3]
If you have any enquiries about anything regarding Before Sunset. You can post them in the discussion and I will do my best to assist you!
